# BAR_REGISTRY (W-BAR, regenerated by code/th_bars/gen_registry.py from code/th_bars/spec.py; csv beside it)

OWNERSHIP SPLIT (user order 18:06Z BAR-SWAP): W-BAR = TIME, ACTIVITY (trades-based), PRICE (range/Renko family/P&F/Kagi/line-break/swing/momentum/trend), simple INFORMATION (imbalance/run/delta/cdr/vol-normalised/CUSUM/directional-change), the trades table, loader, property screen and registry. W-BAR2 = book/quote-based (qmid, micro, bmsg), entropy, footprint, TPO/profile, anchored, session-relative equal-range, composite (range-or-time etc.), smoothing/Heikin-Ashi. W-SWA/W-SWB run the live books on these bars. Storage /mnt/l2/l2vast/_bars/<id>_<size>/<YYYYMM>.parquet; loader code/th_bars/bars.py load(id,size,start,end,sessions).

Size grids: 6-16 sizes per type chosen to give roughly 30-600 bars per session over London/NY AM/NY PM/Asia (verified counts on the build page). All thresholds are fixed at session open from TRAILING statistics only (prior 20 trading dates, median); R0 unit constants = median of the first 60 trading dates; no look-ahead. 1-minute time bars are REFERENCE ONLY.
NT8 named types mapped: Tick->tick, Volume->vol, Range->rng, Second->time_s, Minute->time_m, Renko->renko, HeikenAshi->ha, Kagi->kagi, PointAndFigure->pnf, LineBreak->lbrk, Volumetric->vfp, UniRenko->urenko, MedianRenko/MeanRenko->mrenko, FlexRenko/HybridRenko->frenko, BetterRenko->wrenko, TrendBars->trend, DeltaBars->dlt, MomentumBars->mom, dollar bars->dol. Third-party names not in NT8 core (Sierra Chart: Volume-Weighted/Range-with-reversal, Number-of-Trades, Daily-range; TradingView: Range/Renko/Kagi/Line Break/P&F/Heikin-Ashi; MultiCharts: Range, Renko, Kagi, Line Break, Point&Figure, Volume, Tick, Momentum, Constant-range) all map onto rows here.
